description.en: Shorthand for CreateEvLowMdlForMatch with its _no_bustup argument forced to true — creates a low-detail match roster model without its bustup portrait.
Name to assign the created model.
Whether the character is displayed on the "upper" match side.
Param ID of the match roster member to create.
Optional team slot the member belongs to (defaults to 2).
Handle of the newly created character model.

example.code:
// Create a low-detail match roster model without a bustup portrait
local hMemberL = CreateEvLowMdlForMatchNoBustup("memberL", true, "para_cp0010");
